title: Add revision-aware repository artifact nodes
summary: Links based only on display names or filesystem paths will silently break across branches, renames and bundle refreshes. Define RepositoryArtifactReference with repository identity, revision, artifact kind, stable logical ID, source path and last-known snapshot; surface resolved, stale, missing and changed states.
acceptance_criteria: RepositoryArtifactReference includes repository identity, revision, artifact kind, stable logical ID, source path and a last-known snapshot.
Resolution distinguishes current, changed, stale revision, missing, inaccessible and offline states.
Repository nodes render from the stored snapshot first and refresh explicitly; opening a Board never silently changes its content.
Refreshing produces a reviewable delta rather than overwriting user-authored Board labels, position or annotations.
Component, view and ticket/proposal references can use the same base contract with typed payloads.
Tests cover rename, missing revision, offline opening, changed source path and successful refresh.
No GitHub credential or live-network requirement enters BoardCore.

evidence.note: Components and views already carry logical IDs and source provenance.
Source evidence and stable component/view/token IDs are authoring principles.
HumbleStudio routinely loads artifacts from repository URLs and known apps.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-010, requested by Jan.

agent_notes: Board changes must remain proposal-first and must not mutate source truth unless a future separately accepted apply contract permits it.
Do not broaden this slice into real-time collaboration, arbitrary source rewrite or a provider-specific AI architecture.
Rejected alternative: Store only local absolute source paths — They are not portable across machines, branches or bundles.
